title: Credit Builder Accounts Fee Schedule: Late Fees, Returned Payments and Courtesy Waivers
content:
Fee figures for Credit Builder Accounts, plan by plan.

| Plan | Late-fee grace period (calendar days) | Late-fee percent | Late-fee maximum (USD) | Most late fees per due date | Returned-payment fee (USD) | Courtesy waivers per 12 months | Fee waiver request window (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Credit Builder 600 Plan | 15 | 5.0 | 15.00 | 1 | 10.00 | 1 | 60 |
| Credit Builder 1000 Plan | 15 | 5.0 | 15.00 | 1 | 10.00 | 1 | 60 |
| Credit Builder 1200 Plan | 15 | 5.0 | 15.00 | 1 | 10.00 | 1 | 60 |
| Credit Builder 1800 Plan | 15 | 5.0 | 15.00 | 1 | 10.00 | 1 | 60 |
| Credit Builder 2400 Plan | 15 | 5.0 | 15.00 | 1 | 10.00 | 2 | 60 |
| Credit Builder 3000 Plan | 15 | 5.0 | 15.00 | 1 | 10.00 | 2 | 60 |

**Fee-bearing return codes (every plan):** R01, R02, R03, R04, R08, R09, R16 and R20.

## Meaning of each figure

- **Late-fee grace period:** the calendar days after a due date before a late fee may be assessed on a payment still unpaid.
- **Late-fee percent:** the late fee as a percent of the monthly payment.
- **Late-fee maximum:** the highest late fee, in USD.
- **Most late fees per due date:** the most late fees per due date.
- **Returned-payment fee:** the fee per returned payment, in USD.
- **Fee-bearing return codes:** the return codes that carry a returned-payment fee.
- **Courtesy waivers per 12 months:** the courtesy fee waivers per account in any rolling 12 months.
- **Fee waiver request window:** the calendar days after a fee's assessment date within which a courtesy waiver may be requested.

The Credit Builder 2400 Plan and the Credit Builder 3000 Plan allow 2 courtesy waivers per 12 months; the four smaller plans allow 1. Every other figure in the schedule is the same on all six plans.
